normalization: The replay checks stable composer/status markers and history-file bytes, not cursor placement, colors, or terminal-cell styling.
The restart case uses one synthetic HERMES_HOME for two Hades processes; other cases use fresh homes.
History timestamps are ignored; leading + records, newline reconstruction, duplicate byte stability, and the loaded-entry boundary are asserted.
The cap case sends repeated Up keys at a controlled interval and records the representative key byte once.
